response.message: A feature cannot depend on itself
Implemented markers move only while an epic is REFINED (being implemented): epic <id:2> is REPORTED.
dependsOnTaskId would create a dependency cycle
An epic cannot move from REPORTED to DONE
Epic <id:2> is REPORTED, a draft with no frozen scope to supersede — edit it, or drop it.
The scope of epic <id:2> is frozen: it is REFINED, and scope is editable only at REPORTED. Move the epic back to REPORTED to reopen its scope.
